description: Integrate T(x)-T_ground at segment centers over available pre-cutoff hydraulic intervals under the existing heat-loss scenario and length-center on the full section. Require finite inlet temperature, positive liquid density and velocity, and usable diameter. Use bounded one-day intervals. Leave unobserved time outside the feature. The control uses the same observed duration and a single profile evaluated at duration-weighted average inlet temperature and mass flow. Unavailable temporal profiles fall back to the frozen spatial prediction for the entire section.
